## Code Review Summary
Mode: specification, repair pass r2. Candidate ticket05-spec-r2; sha supplied, not recomputed (read-only, no shell). Files Reviewed: 1 candidate + 15 cited source/anchor files. Total Issues: 8 — HIGH 2, MEDIUM 4, LOW 2.

Closure verified: F1 CLOSED (one transformed value feeds tools.go:1048 and 1090-1095; carrier-completeness). F3 CLOSED (Id/Name/Type, AC5 restated). F4 CLOSED (shape first). F5 CLOSED (error/full/select/no-match rows). F7 CLOSED (bounds + absent!=empty). F8 CLOSED (3 NEW+12 MOD, deps T1+T3, RED wording). F6 NOT CLOSED (N3). F2 PARTIAL (N2, N4). Anchors spot-checked: schema.go:93, log.go:90/282, envelope.go:731, log_test.go:69, bounds.go:315/365-388, tools.go:879/1328.

N1 [HIGH][statement-contradiction] spec:16,82,85,59
Confidence HIGH.
Issue: R6/AC6(d) require skip-pass-through when items miss ALL requested/default fields; R4/AC3 require post-dispatch unknown_field_selection rejection when a field is absent from every item — same fixture, opposite outcomes. AC6(d) also widened r1's "default" to "requested/default", contradicting spec:5 "AC semantics preserved".
Fix: default-all-missing => skip; fields-unknown => reject; scope AC6(d) to non-object/non-list carriers.

N2 [HIGH][statement-contradiction] spec:38,105; config/bounds.go:315; result_handle.go:464
Confidence HIGH.
Issue: maximal disclosure modeled as "16x64 raw bytes", but these are caller strings marshaled into preview/page/terminal metadata; escapedJSONRuneLength shows 6x for <>&/control, so 16x64x6=6144 > 1536 preview ceiling. The config feasibility check passes while a legal 16-field request yields an empty preview (boundedResultPrefix ""), falsifying "feasibility stays sound". If sizing maps carry a maximal shape unconditionally, page splits change for unprojected calls, breaking R7/AC4 byte-identity.
Fix: bound disclosure by encoded width (admission alphabet/cap); service sizing maps mirror actual disclosure; config sets use maximal encoded shape; add escaped-max oracle.

N3 [MEDIUM][statement-contradiction] spec:35,60,66,83
Confidence HIGH.
Issue: F6/C7 label non-matching docker_proxy paths "docker_proxy"; AC4/C1 require "not_allowlisted" for docker_proxy /images/json.
Fix: label by entry match; amend F6/C7 or AC4 consistently.

N4 [MEDIUM][statement-contradiction] spec:63,81; bounded_delivery.go:34,49,133,147
Confidence HIGH.
Issue: C4/AC2/R2 require terminal metadata disclosure, but the terminal branch has no resultEntry (commit failure/retirement) and renderResultTerminal+terminalResult build fresh maps; T2 threads only commit/preview/page, so the entry-carried mechanism cannot reach terminal.
Fix: extract disclosure from deliverBoundedResult's result; pass to both terminal builders and terminalSizingMetadata; add terminal fixture (MaxRetainedResultBytes=1).

N5 [MEDIUM][statement-contradiction] spec:99,100,112,129; result_handle_test.go:61,121,166,211,304
Confidence HIGH.
Issue: extending commit's signature breaks 5 existing call sites in a file outside the exact 3+12 write set, contradicting "existing tests pass unmodified".
Fix: add result_handle_test.go to T2, or preserve arity (options/variadic).

N6 [MEDIUM][statement-contradiction] spec:54,59-60
Confidence HIGH.
Issue: the normative single-source D-table has no row for match+absent/fields shape failures (payload_unparseable, payload_shape_unexpected, item_shape_unexpected, structured_content_not_mirrorable) that AC6(d) requires; full+IsError yields upstream_error per AC6(a') but full_requested per spec:54.
Fix: enumerate carrier-failure rows with reasons; reconcile full+error.

N7 [LOW][undefined-term] spec:14,61
Confidence MEDIUM.
Issue: projection:{} and {"full":false} map to no request mode; non-allowlisted behavior (projection key?) undefined.
Fix: define wire->request mapping or reject as malformed_request.

N8 [LOW][stale-citation] spec:25,26,43
Confidence HIGH.
Issue: E11 1075-1080 => actual 1090-1095; E12 50/64/164 => 52/70/133; E5 describeTool 583 => 569; §4 "after tools.go:1119" => call site 1000 (1119 is the helper declaration).
Fix: update anchors.

Open questions: single-source wording may imply re-marshaling pass-through paths, breaking R7 byte-identity (CallToolResult round-trip drops unknown upstream fields); endpoint Type inferred from the types filter, not an observed response key; select:"" presence undefined.

Positives: F1 root fix is solid (one value + carrier completeness + whole-marshal oracle); F7 explicit bounds with absent!=empty; event registration tied to a render/non-violation test; write-set arithmetic matches; ticket 01 paging reused before retention.

### Recommendation
REQUEST CHANGES
